about:
Source Engineering & Manufacturing operates from Plymouth, Minnesota, providing total manufacturing services from consignment to complete turnkey assembly. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, control panels, box builds, rack assemblies, fluid and pneumatic utility boxes, and electronic controls. It also offers tape-and-reel packaging for SMT components and PCB assembly. Work focuses on low-volume, high-technology equipment and small-to-medium production runs, though facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Primary customers are capital equipment manufacturers in the automation and semiconductor sectors. The company states it serves those industries with tailored cable and panel solutions.

Source Engineering emphasizes three differentiators: cutting-edge technology and advanced machinery for precision and consistency; an experienced staff with years of custom cable assembly expertise; and strict quality control measures throughout the manufacturing process.
